text: Assumption: The decoupling of the daemon-based Diagnostic Management from the application processes serves to safeguard hard UDS timing requirements during isolated application failures — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The decoupling of the daemon-based Diagnostic Management from the application processes serves to safeguard hard UDS timing requirements during isolated application failures — is this correct?
norm: the decoupling of the daemon based diagnostic management from the application processes serves to safeguard hard uds timing requirements during isolated application failures
assumption: The decoupling of the daemon-based Diagnostic Management from the application processes serves to safeguard hard UDS timing requirements during isolated application failures.
rationale: The specification documents AUTOSAR_AP_EXP_SWArchitecture and AUTOSAR_SWS_Diagnostics describe the daemon architecture and channel recovery in detail, but mention the fail-safe philosophy for external diagnostic testers only implicitly.

original.text: Annahme: Die Entkopplung des daemon-basierten Diagnostic Managements von den anwendenden Prozessen dürfte der Absicherung harter UDS-Timing-Anforderungen bei isolierten Applikationsausfällen dienen — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Die Entkopplung des daemon-basierten Diagnostic Managements von den anwendenden Prozessen dürfte der Absicherung harter UDS-Timing-Anforderungen bei isolierten Applikationsausfällen dienen.
original.rationale: Die Spezifikationsdokumente AUTOSAR_AP_EXP_SWArchitecture und AUTOSAR_SWS_Diagnostics beschreiben die Daemon-Architektur und die Kanal-Wiederherstellung detailliert, benennen die Ausfallsicherheitsphilosophie für externe Diagnosetester jedoch nur implizit.
